description: This file defines a utility enum 'SessionKey' with static functions for handling session key strings, including normalization, creation, and validation.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Normalizes a raw session key string by trimming whitespace and defaulting empty strings to 'main'.

methods.name: makeAgentSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs a session key for an agent based on its ID and a base key, with whitespace trimming and default values.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a given session key string is a canonical main session key, specifically 'global' or starting with 'agent:'.
